name: dandi-kb-dashboard
description: Set up a Markdown knowledge base that Claude keeps for you (classified notes, a todo file, log/find/todo/report commands), then view it as one local HTML dashboard — todos by status and due date, published artifact links, tips, records by type, tags, search. The scaffold never overwrites existing files; the dashboard is view-only and stays on your PC. Manual invocation only. Skill instructions are written in Korean.
